result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/FractionAgentTest.java` — 72 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `Fraction`'s factory methods, arithmetic operations, conversions, string formatting, `equals`/`hashCode`/`compareTo`, and boundary/overflow cases (e.g. `Integer.MIN_VALUE` negation overflow, zero denominators, null arguments, `pow(Integer.MIN_VALUE)` overflow). All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
